meta_description:
bestvacations on April 16, 2026: "Saudi Arabia is honestly one of our favorite destinations on Earth. The people, the landscapes, the energy! It’s truly unforgettable!

We’ve personally been to Saudi Arabia twice. Once chasing the golden-hour light over Hegra’s ancient tombs in AlUla, and once standing on the Edge of the World watching the sun drop over endless desert. Still takes our breath away every time. Pure magic. We can’t recommend this destination enough!".
